_meta.groupingPrinciple: Sheets group icons likely to be re-touched together (ADR-0016: regen unit is the sheet, all 3 cells regenerate together). Equip: 5 sheets chunk the 15 slot+weaponType icons sequentially (main x5, sub x5, other x5) — 2 sheets cross a sub-category boundary (main/sub, sub/other) only to keep the pack at exactly 5 sheets / 0 leftover; the other 5 sheets group the 15 uniques by slot family (M2 main trio, M3 main trio, sub+armor, armor+shield+engine, core+module x2). Skill: the 9 stats that have all 3 tier bands each get their own dedicated 3-cell sheet (a stat's low/mid/high progression is the textbook case of "revised together"); the 3 stats with fewer than 3 bands (bulletCount, bulletSpeedPct, rangeFlat) are kept isolated in their own sheets rather than mixed with unrelated stats, so a fix to one never forces a regen of an unrelated stat — this is what produces the 4 leftover cells the task anticipated. Capstones get a dedicated sheet (qualitative art, not a stat). Sticker: kept in the fixed STICKERS array order (index is a wire contract, non-reorderable) chunked sequentially.
_meta.styleNote: style phrase applied uniformly per ADR-0016 anchor pb-equip-icon: "soft cartoon pixel art, high detail, warm cream-gold rim light, no heavy dark outline, transparent background, no text labels, no panel frame, no background plate"
